persistence.commit_boundary: one complete SGD document update, full float64 weights, optimizer settings and cumulative cursor/usage in one worker-fenced transaction
persistence.migration: reuse additive payload/binding tables; distinct neural binding and resume schemas; no new store or runtime service
persistence.rollback: retain payload-backed neural checkpoints; disable neural trainer without discarding training or dataset authority

algorithm.optimizer: plain SGD with global gradient norm clipping; no momentum or adaptive slots
algorithm.ordering: epochs in order, documents in registered order, hidden state reset per document
algorithm.random_state: manifest seed initializes parameters once; SGD contains no stochastic draws, shuffling or dropout
algorithm.base_identity: manifest.base_model_digest must equal the initialized model digest, including run-specific model ID and full neural config

resume_payload.step_semantics: cumulative UTF-8 byte targets plus one EOS target per document per epoch; every completed document is one SGD update
resume_payload.budgets: max_steps and max_tokens bound cumulative targets; max_documents and max_updates bound cumulative document updates; max_training_bytes bounds cumulative UTF-8 document bytes across epochs; max_corpus_bytes bounds registered corpus ingress; max_epochs bounds configured epochs
resume_payload.identity: TrainingCheckpoint.payload_digest binds full weights, optimizer, cursor, usage and loss evidence; model_digest binds float64 parameter bytes

recovery: validate quality-gated dataset, rights, materialized document identity and dataset authority epoch before model work
persist initialized model and initial corpus loss at cursor zero before the first update
advance worker epoch before recovering a running or failed run; allow empty recovery only for exactly bound startup work
restore full parameters and SGD settings after fencing, then continue from the returned authoritative epoch/document cursor
assert dataset authority before updates; serialize checkpoint and terminal commits against revocation using the existing dataset training_authority SQLite guard
a finished checkpoint includes actual final corpus loss and reloads idempotently without retraining or state mutation
failures: manifest/base/config/corpus mismatch fails before an SGD update
nonfinite parameters or loss fail closed
payload/binding corruption prevents resume or artifact loading
stale worker cannot checkpoint, emit telemetry or terminalize replacement work
budget exhaustion never resets usage on restart
scope_limitations: no general AI masterplan closure or signoff
